Dia memicit isinya ke dalamnya dengan mantap sementara seringai lebarnya berkedut dalam campuran nikmat dan sakit, sementara matanya meninjau setiap pergerakan kecil Harry.

e97bd66adceb.en: “Good—” Eori ran her eyes up and down Harry as he chugged the bottle like a frat college kid in a hazing party. She chewed the last piece of her meat stick; meat juice and sauce ran down her lips and chin, dripping onto her pinkish clothing.
e97bd66adceb.t: “Bagus—” Eori memandang Harry atas bawah sambil dia meneguk botol itu seperti budak kolej persaudaraan dalam parti buli. Dia mengunyah kepingan terakhir batang dagingnya; jus daging dan sos mengalir di bibir dan dagunya, menitis ke atas pakaian kemerahannya.

eaa196283fac.en: Morika? A strangely familiar name, Harry, couldn’t put a face to it. Regardless, not daring to look towards her, Harry kept making kebabs. “Sorry! I’m close—can you light the fire?” He continued to stick one root medallion, then a chunk of purple flesh after another, in the most wooden stick in his hand.
eaa196283fac.t: Morika? Satu nama yang anehnya dikenali, Harry, tidak dapat mengaitkannya dengan wajah. Walau bagaimanapun, tidak berani memandang ke arahnya, Harry terus membuat kebab. “Maaf! Saya dah dekat siap—boleh awak nyalakan api?” Dia terus mencucuk satu kepingan ubi, kemudian seketul daging ungu demi seketul, pada lidi kayu di tangannya.

eae7b8c19c27.en: Morika? A faint memory of himself nearly passing out on the experimentation table and hearing Eori upstairs screaming at someone came to mind. Then another memory of being up on the stairs and seeing a glimpse of a behemoth of a humanoid outside the door staring intently towards him. *Maybe that’s the guy I keep seeing delivering stuff?—*Harry kept silent at the memory that a certain someone, looking almost double his own height, straddled around carrying boxes like it was nothing despite wearing a heavy yellowish armor containing pointy spikes—as if he were a cheval-de-frise in the shape of a human. His heart skipped a beat, making him lose focus on nearly shoving his hand instead of a chunk of purple meat into a skewer. His mind came up with a vivid imagination of this spiked monster outside, somewhere, always keeping a watchful eye. *But wait—*Harry looked to the fresh, deep blue curtains that were installed recently. Could it be that this is some weird callsign instead of a name like Sanbi-eye? Could there be more Morikas around?
eae7b8c19c27.t: Morika? Ingatan samar tentang dirinya hampir pengsan di atas meja eksperimen dan mendengar Eori di tingkat atas menjerit kepada seseorang muncul di fikiran. Kemudian satu lagi ingatan tentang berada di atas tangga dan sekilas melihat humanoid raksasa di luar pintu merenung tajam ke arahnya. *Mungkin tu mamat yang aku asyik nampak hantar barang?—*Harry diam memikirkan ingatan bahawa seseorang tertentu, kelihatan hampir dua kali ganda ketinggiannya sendiri, berjalan terkangkang membawa kotak-kotak seolah-olah tiada apa-apa walaupun memakai perisai berat kekuningan yang mempunyai duri-duri tajam—seolah-olah dia ialah cheval-de-frise dalam bentuk manusia. Jantungnya terlepas satu degupan, membuatkannya hilang fokus dan hampir mencucuk tangannya dan bukannya seketul daging ungu ke dalam lidi. Fikirannya mencipta imaginasi yang jelas tentang raksasa berduri ini di luar, di suatu tempat, sentiasa memerhati dengan berjaga-jaga. *Tapi kejap—*Harry memandang langsir biru pekat yang baru dipasang baru-baru ini. Mungkin ke ni sejenis panggilan kod pelik dan bukannya nama macam Sanbi-eye? Mungkin ada lebih ramai Morika kat sekeliling?

eb17b13c17bd.en: Harry could smell himself, but that smell didn’t feel like his. It smelled like there was a horse in the room. Hmmmmm—this stinks! Something in his mind changed. Things no longer felt right—his throbbing penis, his pounding heart were still there, but now started to feel like there were entities of its own, acting and thinking on their own terms.
eb17b13c17bd.t: Harry dapat menghidu dirinya sendiri, tetapi bau itu tidak terasa seperti miliknya. Ia berbau seperti ada seekor kuda dalam bilik. Hmmmmm—busuknya! Sesuatu dalam fikirannya berubah. Keadaan tidak lagi terasa betul—zakarnya yang berdenyut, jantungnya yang berdegup masih ada, tetapi kini mula terasa seperti mereka entiti tersendiri, bertindak dan berfikir mengikut terma mereka sendiri.

eca47d3f5c16.en: Harry stood by himself in quite a familiar kitchen in the late afternoon glow of another day.
eca47d3f5c16.t: Harry berdiri seorang diri di dapur yang agak dikenalinya dalam cahaya lewat petang satu lagi hari.

efdaaca226ac.en: Eori pointed at him, "Go fucking get me breakfast!" then entered the house and shut the door with a loud slam.
efdaaca226ac.t: Eori menunjuk ke arahnya, "Pergi buat sarapan untuk aku sial!" kemudian masuk ke dalam rumah dan menutup pintu dengan hempasan kuat.

f1d807daff4f.en: Eori took a few silent seconds, only to then make a swift no with her head and walk back towards the house.
f1d807daff4f.t: Eori mengambil beberapa saat dalam diam, hanya untuk kemudian menggeleng kepala dengan pantas dan berjalan kembali ke arah rumah.

f352397937a1.en: This might still be better than being a Sanbi eye! The thought passed by his mind, but at the same time, a wanderlust feeling was gnawing in the back of his head. He could barely picture anything from his previous life—the one before suddenly appearing at Sanbi Castle—but he could feel a repetition there as well. Is this what I did previously? I do feel like I ate a lot—wait—no! I would go somewhere every day, too. Somewhere I didn't like at all—except I wasn’t walking there either—did I have a ho-egua too? If so, then where would that be? A very blurry memory of being seated between his parents, watching TV with a dog sleeping nearby, came to mind, but its whereabouts were just as elusive as knowing where he is right now.
f352397937a1.t: Ni mungkin masih lebih baik daripada jadi Sanbi eye! Fikiran itu terlintas di fikirannya, tetapi pada masa yang sama, perasaan ingin mengembara menggigit belakang kepalanya. Dia hampir tidak dapat membayangkan apa-apa dari kehidupan sebelumnya—yang sebelum tiba-tiba muncul di Istana Sanbi—tetapi dia dapat merasa pengulangan di situ juga. Ni ke yang aku buat dulu? Aku memang rasa aku banyak makan—kejap—tak! Aku akan pergi ke suatu tempat setiap hari juga. Suatu tempat yang aku langsung tak suka—kecuali aku tak berjalan ke sana juga—aku ada ho-egua juga ke? Kalau ya, kat mana tu? Ingatan yang sangat kabur tentang duduk di antara ibu bapanya, menonton TV dengan seekor anjing tidur berdekatan, muncul di fikiran, tetapi keberadaannya sama sukar difahami seperti mengetahui di mana dia berada sekarang.

f3a94744083a.en: “Oh yeah?” The panine machine that was Eori's feet now turned into double pin rollers, perhaps trying to knead the dough to make it grow. Gulping down what she had eaten, she took a big sip of the glass beakers by her, containing a slightly jellified concoction.  Eori let out a long, pleasured breath, “FUUUUCCK YEAHH! That’s fucking sapphire!”
f3a94744083a.t: “Oh ya?” Mesin panini yang merupakan kaki Eori kini bertukar menjadi penggelek pin berkembar, mungkin cuba menguli doh supaya ia membesar. Menelan apa yang telah dimakannya, dia meneguk besar dari bikar kaca di sebelahnya, mengandungi ramuan yang sedikit berjeli.  Eori melepaskan nafas panjang yang nikmat, “CELAAAKAAA YAAA! Tu memang sapphire sial!”

f4c0c956f5d6.en: At least she hasn’t injected me with Body Paralyze. That’s nice. A single thought perused through his brain, preferring to just watch it all happen.
f4c0c956f5d6.t: Sekurang-kurangnya dia tak suntik aku dengan Body Paralyze. Tu bagus. Satu fikiran meneliti otaknya, lebih suka hanya menonton semuanya berlaku.

f5051b82f726.en: His hands stalled for a bit, letting the freezer fog dissipate into the warm room of a summer evening. I guess that thing that looked like celery was more minty than I remember. Part of him wanted to experiment and discover the unknown, but the risk of pissing off Eori was growing louder. Maybe tomorrow! I could do something small as a side dish first.
f5051b82f726.t: Tangannya terhenti seketika, membiarkan kabus peti sejuk beku lenyap ke dalam bilik hangat petang musim panas. Rasanya benda yang nampak macam saderi tu lebih berpudina daripada yang aku ingat. Sebahagian dirinya mahu bereksperimen dan meneroka yang tidak diketahui, tetapi risiko membuat Eori marah semakin kuat. Mungkin esok! Aku boleh buat sesuatu yang kecil sebagai lauk sampingan dulu.

f7cd1fdaf979.en: "To create more lube—and—ahh FUCK ME! " Eori moaned angrily as her uncontrollable shivering hips backed away a bit, while beads of sweat coursed through her entire body. She bit her lips hard, nearly drawing blood as she powered through what had to be an orgasm to continue the experiment, "NEED—MORE—Improve the girth—flexibility!"
f7cd1fdaf979.t: "Untuk hasilkan lebih banyak pelincir—dan—ahh CELAKA BETUL! " Eori merintih dengan marah sementara pinggulnya yang menggigil tanpa kawalan berundur sedikit, sementara titisan peluh mengalir di seluruh badannya. Dia menggigit bibirnya dengan kuat, hampir mengeluarkan darah sambil dia bertahan melalui apa yang pasti orgasma untuk meneruskan eksperimen itu, "PERLU—LAGI—Perbaiki ukur lilit—kelenturan!"

fada57d250ab.en: “—the whiskers are used for detecting prey through the dirt—or walls if added to a nari gel!” Releasing the spell on the bottom of the brick stove, the soul rings in Eori’s forearm clashed forward into the back of her hand, transforming into a gust of fire out of her palm and into the slumbering logs, setting them ablaze in crackling agony. “Morika better fucking kill them all before they burrow into my lab!” She spoke under her breath, making her way out of the kitchen.
fada57d250ab.t: “—misai tu digunakan untuk mengesan mangsa melalui tanah—atau dinding kalau ditambah dalam nari gel!” Melepaskan jampi di bahagian bawah dapur bata, gelang-gelang jiwa di lengan bawah Eori berlanggar ke hadapan ke belakang tangannya, berubah menjadi hembusan api dari tapak tangannya ke dalam kayu-kayu yang tidur, membakarnya dalam penderitaan yang berderak-derak. “Morika lebih baik bunuh semua sebelum ia gali masuk makmal aku!” Dia berkata di bawah nafasnya, keluar dari dapur.

fb1323e54010.en: Eori's arm forcefully pushed him backward out of the way to access the sigil rings and nari stone in the cupboard with an angry-sounding sniffle.
fb1323e54010.t: Lengan Eori dengan kuat menolak Harry ke belakang dari laluan untuk mencapai cincin sigil dan batu nari dalam almari dengan hingusan yang kedengaran marah.

fbae4e59b8e4.en: “What’s a cat?” Eori spoke beside him as she went back to the cabinet to drop the sigil ring, then grabbed a nari stick to feed the spell. “Cat—huh?” She spoke under her breath as she touched the pointy end of the nari stick to the same palm she had touched the sigil ring. Closing the hands in an eating motion, the blue light within the nari stick got slurped into the palm, creating a fireball that spun around one of the soul rings.
fbae4e59b8e4.t: “Apa tu kucing?” Eori bercakap di sebelahnya sambil dia kembali ke kabinet untuk meletakkan cincin sigil, kemudian mengambil batang nari untuk menyuapkan jampi. “Kucing—hah?” Dia berkata di bawah nafasnya sambil dia menyentuhkan hujung tajam batang nari pada tapak tangan yang sama yang telah disentuhnya dengan cincin sigil. Menutup tangan dalam gerakan makan, cahaya biru dalam batang nari itu disedut ke dalam tapak tangan, mencipta bola api yang berputar mengelilingi salah satu gelang jiwa.

fffc7a3e2ffc.en: His hands grabbed a handful of chunks of purple meat and closed the ice preserver softly, plopping the purple meat bundle into one side of the cutting board. With a sharp knife, he started to chop the purple meat meticulously as the chains tugging his wrists rustled against the table. Despite the meat being cold and rigid, it felt like cutting through butter. His imagination got the better of him, imagining the knife cutting through his finger like butter. His fingers clenched at the thought, making him squint his eyes to be even more precise with it.
fffc7a3e2ffc.t: Tangannya mengambil segenggam ketulan daging ungu dan menutup pengawet ais dengan perlahan, menghenyakkan berkas daging ungu itu ke satu sisi papan pemotong. Dengan pisau tajam, dia mula memotong daging ungu itu dengan teliti sementara rantai yang menarik pergelangan tangannya bergeser pada meja. Walaupun daging itu sejuk dan keras, ia terasa seperti memotong mentega. Imaginasinya menguasainya, membayangkan pisau itu memotong jarinya seperti mentega. Jari-jarinya mengepal memikirkannya, membuatkannya mengecilkan mata untuk lebih tepat lagi.
